verdict.rationale: Notte's in-product AI mostly runs agents and does LLM-powered extraction: it turns web pages into structured data or markdown, and its LinkedIn guide extracts a user's own messages. That only glancingly matches AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, since it extracts content rather than analyzing it or recommending anything. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis over the user's data, proactive suggestions or recommendations surfaced in the product, documentation of any insights feature, and independent corroboration.
